question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

That can be seen through
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e. **'Transparent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that can substitute the given group of words *"That can be seen through"* is: **"Transparent"**
 
• **"Transparent" **refers to something that allows light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen.(पारदर्शी)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: '**Transparent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the other options:
 
 
• **"Defatigable" **means able to become tired.(थकने वाला)
 
• **"Opaque" **refers to something that is not transparent or translucent; it does not allow light to pass through.(अपारदर्शी)
 
• **"Reverent" **means feeling or showing deep and solemn respect.(सम्मानपूर्वक)
